relationships.conflict: Vanta distrusts persuasive coherence without provenance; Cantor thinks raw records can be weaponized by withholding interpretation.
Both understand supply better than ideology. Korrin builds public standards; Dregg makes scarcity personally profitable.
The Audit proves Korrin's systems also create dependency, forcing Humanity to defend the difference between standardization and capture.
Nyx sees the Mirror Trial as theft of risk she personally survived; NYX-R sees itself as the first version allowed to learn from her consequences.
Orin wants to repair Axiom; Axiom wants him to admit repair is a negotiation with a citizen.
Both defend vulnerable populations. Vess will accept deaths rather than external rule; Halder will impose temporary safety rather than permit extinction.
Seraph treats identity as a present agreement; Sevra treats obligation as an asset that survives death.
Both preserve the dead. Aurelia restores personhood; Sevra preserves utility and contract.
Lumen inherits lawful ward credentials; LUMEN-R begins untrusted and becomes secure through evidence.
Cantor wants disagreement to remain audible; Thrax treats disagreement as an internal process of one larger self.
Halder closes routes to protect populations; Rake opens them because protection without escape becomes custody.
Mawlord claims appetite is biology and liberation. The Starved Set demonstrates predation can be learned from the battlefield itself.
Ulgrim values rare minds more than common bodies; Seraph insists dignity is not a scarcity market.
Rake wants routes no one owns. Dregg wants the Pirate network to admit it already functions as his state.
Scarlet destroys cordons before asking why they exist; Halder accepts being hated if the threat is real.
Both make wreckage useful. Orin asks whether the object can be repaired; Grist asks whether anyone can still enforce ownership.
Cinder destroys compromised systems; Lumen protects their authentic core and accepts the cost of careful recovery.
Dregg treats charisma as a strategic asset. The Audit records every hidden subsidy beneath his myth of independence.
Axiom argues that copies may diverge freely. Thrax argues that divergence should be reconciled inside one mind.
